 Amy Falls – From Bonds to Boards to Leading Northwestern (Capital Allocators, EP.316) 
 
 Amy Falls – From Bonds to Boards to Leading Northwestern (Capital Allocators, EP.316) May 22, 2023

 Amy Falls is the CIO at Northwestern University, where she
oversees the school’s $14.2 billion endowment that supports
university operations and funds about a quarter of the University’s
annual revenue. She also serves on the Board of Harvard Management
Company, the Ford Foundation, Phillips Academy, and the Pete
Peterson Foundation.

Our conversation covers Amy’s background and path to Northwestern,
frameworks she learned along the way, and different challenges she
faced in three different CIO seats.  We then turn to her
thoughts on manager selection, liquidity, and across asset classes,
covering fixed income, private credit, private equity, public
equity, and China. We close with Amy’s insights from her experience
working with investment committees and parallels between her
passion for farming and investing.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
